problem_statement: The engine must verify the integrity of the real pbuilder-runner.js before exec'ing code it does not own. The runner is thin and multi-file, so neither digest-pinning nor a bundle hash applies; it needs a manifest of the runner's static import closure, which only the SDK can produce.
